evidence: Initializes output title COLLECT OPTIONS, resolves DATA_C_CURRENT and reads quantity, is_collectable and id. Emits menu entries View in Marketplace and Auto Select, conditionally Lock Card (NOT Collectable) or Unlock Card (Make Collectable), then CANCEL. decompiled/main/main_0083.c:54294-54366. No direct lifted caller or constant dispatch target was found. QA decomp_03_wave22_review.jsonl: Decoded output title, item keys and option strings directly from the NSO at their lifted addresses. DATA_C_CURRENT is the source, with quantity, is_collectable and id reads. Quantity controls whether the lock/unlock entry is included and is_collectable selects one of the two labels. Writes option records and returns 3 or 4 on this path. Searched generated numeric references and found no caller or registration. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0083.c:54294-54369.

No direct lifted caller or constant dispatch target was found. QA decomp_03_wave22_review.jsonl: Independently decoded both value keys and the prompt/options from the NSO, including prompt offset 0x1c6eecc. Searched generated numeric references and found no caller or registration. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0084.c:47411-47456, decompiled/main/main_0085.c:30311-30356.

Supplies league_id and mlb_team_id to property helpers, then reads league_team and player_id. Depending on the lookup path it either writes a comparison flag at the incoming object's +0x11 or stores a sign-extended player id at +0x40 of a nested object. The larger callback role is unresolved. decompiled/main/main_0066.c:34117-34198. No direct lifted caller or constant dispatch target was found. QA decomp_03_wave22_review.jsonl: Decoded all four named keys from NSO. The ST8 at receiver +0x11 records equality against the context +0x1a0 qword, while the other branch sign-extends the player_id output into nested object +0x40. Registration recovered in f_7000932f94, which allocates a 0x20-byte wrapper, stores this address at wrapper +0x10, and installs the wrapper at owner +0x18. The specific event that invokes this callback remains unresolved. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0066.c:34049-34100, decompiled/main/main_0066.c:34117-34198.

On the eligible path decrements the object's signed countdown at +0x2a64. At expiration selects the actual NSO key DraftRoundsScroller or FantasyDraftRoundsScroller according to global state, resolves that target and supplies its round argument, then resets the countdown to 10. decompiled/main/main_0087.c:36529-36591. No direct lifted caller or constant dispatch target was found. QA decomp_03_wave22_review.jsonl: Decoded DraftRoundsScroller and FantasyDraftRoundsScroller at NSO offsets 0x1ccc12d and 0x1d2b921. The function saves entry x0 in x19, uses LD32 and ST32 at +0x2a64, branches on the signed decrement result and resets the countdown to 10 on the expiration path. The reset occurs even if the target lookup fails. Searched generated numeric references and found no caller or registration. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0087.c:36528-36552, decompiled/main/main_0087.c:36557-36586.
